title: Protocol for differentiation of bovine adipogenic progenitor cells embedded in alginate sheets
protocol: Mix 5 μL of a cell/alginate mixture in the middle of a PDL-coated well of a 96-well plate.
Wash with gelation buffer to initiate alginate polymerization.
Add differentiation medium to the wells.
Exchange the medium weekly over a four-week period.
Fix cells at the end of the four-week period.
Stain cells with a lipid stain.
Analyze differentiation efficiency using a high content analyzer.
Prepare needed reagents.
Mix DMEM/F12 with 1 mM CaCl2 to create gelation buffer.
Edit Python file for run variables.
Change NUM_PLATES to the number of plates you have.
Edit starting tip column in csv.
Insert sheets’ volume and sample number per well (format: [<volume> - <sample name>) in csv.
Upload edited csv to Jupyter Notebook on Opentrons liquid handler.
Load protocol onto Opentrons App.
Ensure a p300 8-Channel Electronic Pipette (GEN2) is loaded.
Ensure a p20 8-Channel Electronic Pipette (GEN2) is loaded.
Place sterile labware on Opentrons as directed by the app.
Mix the cell/alginate mixture 3 times with the p20 8-channel pipette.
Transfer specified volumes/samples to the middle of the wells.
Slow wash with gelation buffer, ensuring a delay of 5 seconds per well incubation time before removal.
Wash 2× with DMEM/F12.
Remove the last DMEM/F12 wash from the wells.
Add prepared differentiation medium to the wells in the appropriate volume (15 × the volume of the alginate sheets).
Culture the sheets in a humidified atmosphere at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Avoid contact between alginate and Phosphate Buffer Solution (PBS) to maintain sheet stability.
Add 1 mM CaCl2 to wash buffers and differentiation media for sheet stability during culture period.
Use a single channel pipette for dispensing the cell/alginate mixture to place sheets in the middle of wells.
Use a multichannel pipette for gelation and washing, placing it at the sides of the wells to ensure slow liquid flow over the cell/alginate mixture.
Wait until alginate has gelled before handling sheets as standard 2D cultures.
Remove old media from well plates using the liquid handler.
Add new media to well plates using the liquid handler.
Prepare fixation solution (4% PFA in gelation buffer).
Prepare staining solution (Hoechst (1:1000) and Bodipy (1:1000) in gelation buffer).
Add fixation solution to the well plates.
Incubate for 15 min.
Remove fixation solution.
Add staining solution.
Incubate 60 min.
Remove staining solution.
Wash with gelation buffer.
Final addition of gelation buffer to well plates.
